DISCLAIMER - Tide data displayed by the app are based on astronomical tide predictions and do not take into account the effects of strong winds, rain, floods and other meteorological events. 
Do NOT use the app for navigation or any other purpose that may result in personal injury or property damage. Use it at your own risk.

Features:
* Display high and low tides on iPhone, iPod or Apple Watch.
* Moon Phase depiction
* Sunrise, Sunset, Moonrise and Moonset times
* Animation of moon phase and tide changes for quick overview
* Swipe left/right to see the tide chart of the next days
* Thousands of tide stations across the world 
* including USA, Canada, UK, Germany, Australia, New Zealand...
* Offline viewing capability
* View tide station locations on an overview map with offline cache
* Accounts for daylight savings time and different timezones
